notes.title: Introducing Enemy of the State, a top-down noir action shooter

tags.feature: Enemy of the State, a top-down noir action shooter
It’s a brand new game from the creators of War Hospital.
Enemy of the State is a co-op and single-player shooter set in the world of 1920s crime lords.
You play as an aspiring gangster trying to reach the top during the Prohibition era.
Your task is to build the most powerful crime syndicate in the world!
Character customisation, including choosing the ethnicity of your character;
Combat with customizable weapons and a cover system;
Extensive player progression with many available classes;
Player-created syndicates competing with each other online;
